prospect_refinement.method: Median of highest height group with at least two returns per 0.4 m cell; retain densest group if no group has two returns. Groups split at 1 m height gaps. Explicit terrace boundary controls at 0.2 m spacing and every fitted profile break.
prospect_refinement.limitations: A 2.5D cliff envelope cannot represent overhangs. Boundary controls join the stable M1 floor and are not independent measured control. No application acceptance.

nature_house_refinement.method: 0.35 m classified-ground median cells outside measured deck. Upper boundary controls stop 0.50 m before the lower front. Five dense lines at the front replace wall-adjacent classified outliers with a source-fitted lower-ground plane. The high-to-low interior join remains behind the closed wall, at least 0.35 m inside its front.
nature_house_refinement.scope: Local approach refinement only. No lake/water level change, no terrain cut and no interior access.
